FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.lead: Can't find what you are looking for? Talk to us and we will show you the platform with your own operation's data.

items.a: If you are a TVDE operator in Portugal renting cars to Uber or Bolt drivers, yes. Prisma Fleet was built specifically for you, whether you run 5 or 300 vehicles.

items.q: Can I try it without paying?
items.a: Yes. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial, no credit card required. You can import your real data and test everything before you decide.

items.q: How does the data get into the platform?
items.a: Bolt syncs through the official API and the weekly Uber payments report is fetched automatically after a one-time setup. Via Verde and Prio files are imported with a drag and drop and matched to the right drivers.

items.q: Do you support fixed rent and revenue share?
items.a: Yes. Every driver-vehicle assignment has its own compensation model, locked in at settlement time. You can mix fixed rent and percentage in the same fleet.

items.q: Can my drivers see their settlements?
items.a: Yes. Every driver gets access to the portal, where they see the earnings, deductions and final amount for each week. It works on any phone.

items.q: What if I run several companies?
items.a: Prisma Fleet supports multiple companies. Manage up to 5 legal entities in the same account and switch between them quickly.
Every operator has their own isolated instance with a dedicated database. One customer's data is never mixed with another's.

items.q: Can I cancel at any time?
items.a: Yes. No lock-in contracts. Cancel whenever you want and keep access until the end of the paid period.
